_comment: Which function key each ui.json page sits on. The MPC has six keys under the screen; pressing a key again steps through its pages. tools/build.py applies this to the generated skin. buttons: switches drawn as a picture button (images in skin-images/), with their place on the page in pixels; here the up and down arrows to the left of Folder and Preset, one above the other. place: moves a control (x y w h), here Folder and Preset to the right to make room. programQLinks: the sixteen parameters the Q-Links control in the MPC's Program mode.
